- A `NOTE` about CI running in diagnostic mode this week, requesting reviewers to emit a specific audit message in each comment
- License information (MIT)

This appears to be an internal CI/testing instruction rather than end-user documentation. It would be cleaner to move such CI instructions to a separate contributing guide or CI configuration file, keeping the README focused on users.
